description: This file contains the implementation of the App class for a Windows Universal Platform (UWP) application, specifically for unit testing purposes. It includes application lifecycle management, launch handling, suspension handling, and navigation failure handling, as well as integration with the Visual Studio test platform and localization services.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class handling startup, suspension, and navigation failure events.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Constructor initializing the application, setting up suspension event handling.

methods.name: OnLaunched
methods.description: Handles application launch, sets up the main frame, activates the window, and starts the test runner.

methods.name: OnSuspending
methods.description: Handles application suspension, intended to save state.

methods.name: OnNavigationFailed
methods.description: Handles navigation failures by throwing an exception.

calls: throw ref new FailureException("Failed to load Page " + e->SourcePageType.Name)
